Judge only the rule's decision structure. claim_context.value: If export-delay cause remains unresolved, sort requests alphabetically and compare whether latency improves.

evidence_bundle.text: Export requests show intermittent delay. Request labels are arbitrary identifiers independent of size, arrival order and service path. Alphabetical sorting here changes only the display of completed request records, not execution, routing, workload, or any suspected causal variable. The delay cause remains unresolved.

To diagnose a suspected causal variable, vary that variable in a controlled perturbation while keeping workload and measurement fixed, then compare latency. Rearranging a display without changing the causal system is not such a perturbation.
